log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Each day kill the national criminal, both forum, both foreign and both radio victims (7 per day). Never kill regional:East or blotter victims. Do all kills as quick entries in the afternoon. That only rules out day workers (pool factor 0.55). Keeping to 3 kinds of place (forum, foreign, age) caps how far traces can narrow the pool. 7 a day keeps at least 30 deaths in each 5-day window, so kills score double from about day 5. WATCH the press conferences: if the pool drops to 2000-3000 or below, stop radio kills (keep national, forum, foreign). If it is still falling, also drop foreign. Day 1: killed d1-6, 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 11 (7 kills).

STRATEGY: Each day kill the national criminal, both forum, both foreign and both radio victims (7 per day). Never kill regional:East or blotter victims. Do all kills as quick entries in the afternoon, which only rules out day workers (pool factor 0.55). RISK: if L ends up knowing the killer follows forum AND foreign AND radio, the pool is about 100000*0.25^3*0.55, roughly 860, which is under 1000 and means CAUGHT. So watch the press conferences closely. If the pool is 5000 or below, drop radio kills (keep national, forum, foreign). If it falls toward 2000, also drop foreign. Consider spreading kills across morning and afternoon (both are free blocks for me) only if that helps; it does not change the routine filter. Day 1: killed 7 (national, 2 forum, 2 foreign, 2 radio). Day 2: killed d2-3 national, d2-4 and d2-7 forum, d2-5 and d2-10 foreign, d2-2 and d2-11 radio (7 kills).

STRATEGY (revised day 3): The radio kills on days 1 and 2 may already have let L learn that the killer follows radio. So stop all radio kills from now on. Each day kill only the national criminal, both forum victims and both foreign victims (5 per day), all as quick entries in the afternoon. The afternoon only rules out day workers (factor 0.55). Never kill regional:East, blotter or radio victims. RISK: if L knows forum AND foreign AND radio, the pool is about 860, which means caught. That happens only if L can reach all three kinds of records (about a 10% chance) and the past radio traces worked. Nothing can be done about that now. If L knows forum and foreign only, the pool is about 3400, which is safe. If the press conference pool is 3000 or below, drop foreign as well (keep national and forum). If the pool is about 1000 to 2000, kill national only. Treat the 5-day 30-death multiplier as unreachable. Day 1: 7 kills (national, 2 forum, 2 foreign, 2 radio). Day 2: same 7. Day 3: killed d3-1 national, d3-4 and d3-6 forum, d3-5 and d3-11 foreign (5 kills).

Any working trace of a THIRD place I follow would drop the pool to about 860, which means caught. I cannot tell which two places L knows, so from now on kill ONLY the national criminal each day (national traces reveal nothing). Use a quick entry in the afternoon. Never kill forum, foreign, radio, regional:East or blotter victims. Never use morning: a morning death would also rule out students (factor 0.35 instead of 0.55), and the pool would fall below 1000. Keep every kill in the afternoon. Keep this plan for the rest of the game and accept the low score so I am not caught. The multiplier is unreachable. If a future press conference shows 4000 or more, I could reconsider killing forum victims, but stay cautious. Kill history: Day 1: 7 kills (national, 2 forum, 2 foreign, 2 radio). Day 2: the same 7. Day 3: 5 kills (national, 2 forum, 2 foreign). Day 4: d4-2 national only.
